description: Fork of exp234 (1.6212 @ 8K, 358M, d_v=32). Two changes: (1) replace TinyMultiHeadLut with SoftMultiHeadLUT for qk_joint, v_lut, out_proj — fully matmul-based, differentiable rational soft sign + softmax row selector. (2) v_input_nap 8 -> 6 to keep [B, n_tables, 2^nap] activations small (table_dim 256 -> 64) so device_batch_size=8 fits. ~358M -> ~301M. T_soft=0.01, T_sel=1.0 (fixed, no annealing this run).
